description: This file defines the RequestHandler class responsible for managing storage operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications, as well as managing storage info and size calculations. It also declares related data structures and enums for storage actions and app info.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class that manages application storage, providing methods to create, delete, retrieve, and clear storage, as well as handling storage info and size calculations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: SetBaseStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the base directory path for storage.

methods.name: createPersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Creates or initializes the remote store object.

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Releases or cleans up the remote store object.

methods.name: appQuotaSizeProperty
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the quota size for a specific app.

methods.name: populateAppInfoCacheFromStoragePath
methods.description: Populates the internal cache of app storage info from the storage path.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for an app with specified size.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage info for an app.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage for all apps except those exempted.
